            at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            provider TEXT NOT NULL,
            model TEXT NOT NULL,
            chain TEXT NOT NULL,
            purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
            outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('ok', 'error', 'skipped')),
            error_class TEXT,
            http_status INTEGER,
            duration_ms INTEGER,
            prompt_tokens INTEGER CHECK (prompt_tokens IS NULL OR prompt_tokens >= 0),
            completion_tokens INTEGER CHECK (completion_tokens IS NULL OR completion_tokens >= 0),
            reasoning_tokens INTEGER CHECK (reasoning_tokens IS NULL OR reasoning_tokens >= 0),
            cached_tokens INTEGER CHECK (cached_tokens IS NULL OR cached_tokens >= 0),
            request_id TEXT, role TEXT, preset TEXT, cost_micro_usd INTEGER CHECK (cost_micro_usd IS NULL OR cost_micro_usd >= 0), first_token_ms INTEGER CHECK (first_token_ms IS NULL OR first_token_ms >= 0), generation_ms INTEGER CHECK (generation_ms IS NULL OR generation_ms >= 0), system_prompt_tokens INTEGER CHECK (system_prompt_tokens IS NULL OR system_prompt_tokens >= 0), tool_catalog_tokens INTEGER CHECK (tool_catalog_tokens IS NULL OR tool_catalog_tokens >= 0), history_tokens INTEGER CHECK (history_tokens IS NULL OR history_tokens >= 0), user_tokens INTEGER CHECK (user_tokens IS NULL OR user_tokens >= 0), tool_count INTEGER CHECK (tool_count IS NULL OR tool_count >= 0), message_count INTEGER CHECK (message_count IS NULL OR message_count >= 0),
            CHECK (outcome = 'error' OR (error_class IS NULL AND http_status IS NULL))
          )
